name: chart-rises
subject: A person in profile stands beside a big loose computer screen with a bar chart of three bars. Panel 1: no bars yet. Panel 2: bars low. Panel 3: bars higher. Panel 4: bars tall, the person raises one fist.

name: coffee-ripples
subject: A tiny person relaxes inside a big coffee cup, head, shoulders and one arm on the rim. Same pose in every panel; only small ripples on the coffee surface and two steam curls move and change shape from panel to panel.

name: page-turn
subject: A person sits on a stack of books reading an open book, body still. Panel 1: book open flat. Panel 2: one page lifts. Panel 3: the page stands upright. Panel 4: the page lands on the other side.

name: gift-give
subject: A person in profile holds a small gift box with a bow; the box is in every panel. Panel 1: box against the chest. Panel 2: arms move forward. Panel 3: arms stretched out, offering the box. Panel 4: same, head tilted, small smile.

name: laces-tie
subject: Only a pair of sneakers on the ground, no person and no head. Panel 1: laces lying loose. Panel 2: laces crossed. Panel 3: one loop formed. Panel 4: a neat bow tied.

name: thinker
subject: A person sits on a low block, seen in profile. Panel 1: upright, hands on knees. Panel 2: leans forward a little. Panel 3: one elbow on the knee. Panel 4: chin resting on the fist, deep in thought, like the famous thinker statue.

name: run
subject: A person runs toward the right, leaning forward, in profile. Six panels of one run cycle on the same baseline: contact, down, passing, up, contact on the other leg, passing.

name: door-open
subject: A hand on a round knob of a plain door seen from the front, nobody else, line only. Panel 1: hand on the knob. Panel 2: knob turned. Panel 3: door opens a crack, the gap left white. Panel 4: door half open, the gap white, no black fill.

name: camera-flash
subject: A person in profile holds a camera to the eye, nobody else. Panel 1: aiming. Panel 2: finger presses the button. Panel 3: a burst of coral watercolor flash in front of the camera. Panel 4: aiming again. Coral only on the flash.

name: sofa-typing
subject: Close-up of two hands typing on a laptop keyboard resting on knees, outline only. Same framing; only the fingers change. Panel 1: left fingers down. Panel 2: right fingers down. Panel 3: left index down. Panel 4: both hands lifted.

name: accordion
subject: A standing person in profile plays an accordion. Panel 1: bellows closed. Panel 2: bellows half open. Panel 3: bellows wide open, head tilted back. Panel 4: bellows half open.

name: yoga
subject: A person drawn in outline only, body never filled black, does yoga on a mat. Panel 1: standing, palms together. Panel 2: arms raised high. Panel 3: tree pose, one foot against the other knee. Panel 4: warrior pose, arms wide.

name: suitcase-run
subject: A person runs toward the right pulling a rolling suitcase behind. Six panels of one run cycle on the same baseline: contact, down, passing, up, contact on the other leg, passing. Suitcase bounces slightly.

name: envelope-open
subject: Two hands drawn in outline only, never filled, hold an envelope. Panel 1: closed. Panel 2: the flap opens. Panel 3: a letter marked with a big @ slides half out. Panel 4: the letter fully out above the envelope.

name: checklist-tick
subject: A sheet with three wavy lines, each with an empty box, and a pen. Panel 1: boxes empty. Panel 2: first box ticked. Panel 3: second ticked. Panel 4: third ticked, pen lifted.

name: snow-globe
subject: A snow globe on a simple base, a small mountain inside. Same globe in every panel; small snowflake dots fall inside, lower and in new places in each panel.

name: card-pay
subject: A hand holds a bank card above a small loose payment terminal. Panel 1: card above. Panel 2: card touches the terminal. Panel 3: three dots on its small screen. Panel 4: a big check mark on the screen, card lifted.

name: coffee-sip
subject: A person in profile sits at a desk typing on a laptop, a coffee cup beside. Panel 1: typing. Panel 2: hand reaches the cup. Panel 3: lifts the cup to the mouth and sips. Panel 4: puts the cup down.

name: fever
subject: A person in profile holds a phone to the ear, looking tired; a big loose thermometer stands beside. Coral watercolor only inside the thermometer. Panel 1: low level. Panel 2: a third. Panel 3: two thirds. Panel 4: full, head droops a little.

name: binoculars
subject: A person in profile looks far away through binoculars. Panel 1: binoculars at the eyes. Panel 2: lowers the binoculars a little, eye open. Panel 3: same, eye closed in a blink. Panel 4: eye open, raising the binoculars back.
